value.rationale: A single global parity-check constraint is a natural sampling restriction in coding and least-squares approximation. The exact relative stability cost/benefit unexpectedly alternates in n mod 4, with odd/even defects on different scales and infinitely many dimension increases, decreases and plateaux; ordinary unconstrained affine projections have equal consecutive even/odd constants. This identifies when adding one coordinate while enforcing parity worsens or improves sharp noise sensitivity, beyond an arbitrary slice or mere kernel restatement.
